executive_summary: Dover is an AI-powered recruiting automation platform designed specifically for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Founded by George Carollo, who has experience in creating free recruiting tools for startups, the company is part of the Y Combinator W25 batch. While it has a solid foundation and a clear target market, traction signals are limited to its YC batch participation. Overall, Dover presents a promising opportunity in the SMB recruiting space.
